recommendations.description: Initiate a pre-policy claims-processing audit for Y-authorized PPO Local inpatient claims in GA and PA that reconciles AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and Not Mapped facility values to the original authorization, provider/facility crosswalk, and contract adjudication logic for Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, and Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes with MCC, including ATLANTICARE REGIONAL MEDICAL CTR, before changing denial, site-of-care, or reimbursement rules.
evidence: GA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION accounts for about $1.8M across hip/femur, UTI, metabolic, and sepsis admissions.
GA Not Mapped PPO Local authorized claims add about $213K.
PA Not Mapped PPO Local claims include ATLANTICARE REGIONAL MEDICAL CTR and sepsis.

recommendations.description: Initiate a joint UM, claims, and contract compliance audit for GA PPO Local ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions with pa_required_code Y, starting with DCH REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER and the DRGs Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Cellulitis without MCC, Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC, and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, to validate prior authorization-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, admission appropriateness, reimbursement processing, and site-of-care or contract remediation opportunities.
evidence: Authorized GA PPO Local acute hospital admissions increased.
DCH REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER is the main provider concentration.
UTI, cellulitis, hip/femur, and sepsis are the concentrated DRGs.
Pattern identifies a direct UM and provider-performance issue.
peer_benchmarking: Humana policy cited is off-topic and does not address inpatient DRG admission rules.
United Health policy cited addresses molecular panel reimbursement, not inpatient DRG admissions.

recommendations.description: Implement a focused GA inpatient review policy requiring targeted UM review of admission appropriateness, prior-authorization verification, auth-to-claim matching, and denial enforcement for Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, Cellulitis without MCC, and Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC when billed with UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED, ACUTE CYSTITIS WITHOUT HEMATURIA, SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM, CELLULITIS OF LEFT LOWER LIMB, or DSPL IT FX LT FEMUR INITIAL CLOS FX, prioritizing NGMC GAINESVILLE, PIEDMONT FAYETTE HOSPITAL, MOUNT DESERT ISLAND HOSPITAL, and UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND BALTIMORE WASHINGTON MEDICAL CENTER.
evidence: UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED adds about $245K with 30 more admissions.
ACUTE CYSTITIS WITHOUT HEMATURIA is a top dimension in the GA group.
SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM adds about $196K with 21 more admissions.
CELLULITIS OF LEFT LOWER LIMB shows about $2.7K higher paid per admit.
DSPL IT FX LT FEMUR INITIAL CLOS FX adds about $198K.
All highlighted cards show pa_required_code Y in ACUTE HOSPITAL.
Source cards link diagnoses to NGMC GAINESVILLE and PIEDMONT FAYETTE HOSPITAL.
peer_benchmarking: Centene reviews sepsis claims pre/post-pay and may deny, adjust, or reinstate.
Centene requires physician-documented sepsis, organ dysfunction, SOFA increase, cultures, antibiotics, fluids, and SEP-1 screening.

recommendations.description: Implement targeted pre-admit authorization confirmation, concurrent and post-admit review, and auth-to-claim enforcement for PPO Local prior-authorization acute hospital admissions in CA, CT, MO, NY, and PA across Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes with MCC, and Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours without MCC, with provider outreach to SSM HEALTH DEPAUL HOSPITAL - ST. LOUIS.
evidence: Outside GA, recurring theme is admission growth in authorized acute hospital cases.
CA hip/femur admissions increased while paid per admit declined slightly.
CA UTI admissions increased in prior-auth-required acute hospital cases.
SSM HEALTH DEPAUL HOSPITAL - ST. LOUIS shows recurring admission growth in MO.
NY hip/femur and metabolic disorder clusters both show higher inpatient volume.

recommendations.description: Audit the CUMG decision tree, prior-authorization enforcement, and auth-to-claim matching for PPO Local / ACUTE HOSPITAL / pa_required_code Y inpatient admissions in OH, concentrating on MERCY HEALTH - ST. JOSEPH WARREN HOSPITAL and the Miscellaneous Disorders of Nutrition, Metabolism, and Fluids and Electrolytes with MCC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, Cellulitis without MCC, and Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC DRGs, then confirm claims are processing per contractual obligation for higher-paid-per-admit Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC in OH and Cellulitis without MCC in NY.
evidence: OH metabolic disorder admissions added about $117K with 10 more admissions.
MERCY HEALTH ST. JOSEPH WARREN HOSPITAL added about $63K with 7 more admissions.
OH UTI had more admissions and higher paid per admit.
NY cellulitis had more admissions and higher paid per admit.
peer_benchmarking: Humana summary shows no DRG bundling rule; biomarker reimbursement policy is unrelated.
United Health summary shows no site-of-service or DRG bundling rule for these inpatient admissions.

recommendations.description: Establish an OH inpatient electrolyte and fluid-balance admission policy that routes eligible PA-required ER cases to observation or other lower-intensity settings, confirms prior authorization before payment, and applies initial and concurrent review criteria for HYPO-OSMOLALITY AND HYPONATREMIA, FLUID OVERLOAD UNSPECIFIED, HYPOKALEMIA, and HYPEROSMOLALITY AND HYPERNATREMIA.
evidence: Hyponatremia added about $109K with 10 more admissions.
Fluid overload added about $38K with 6 more admissions.
Hypokalemia added about $75K with 6 more admissions.
Hypernatremia added about $55K with higher paid per admit.
All source cards are PA-required ER admissions in OH acute hospitals.
peer_benchmarking: Buckeye Health Plan (WellCare) lists Inpatient Only and Bundles.

recommendations.description: Open provider-level case reviews and itemized bill audits for rare inpatient outliers at MARY WASHINGTON HOSPITAL INC, DCH REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER, and MERCY HEALTH - ST. JOSEPH WARREN HOSPITAL, prioritizing Endovascular Cardiac Valve Replacement and Supplement Procedures without MCC, Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC, Heart Failure and Shock with MCC, Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours with MCC, and Hip and Femur Procedures Except Major Joint with CC to validate CANDIDAL SEPSIS and SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM clinical support, DRG and principal-diagnosis sequencing, final adjudication, contractual processing, and itemized billing.
evidence: MARY WASHINGTON HOSPITAL INC flagged for cardiac valve replacement and sepsis outliers.
DCH REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER shows candidal sepsis and dialysis catheter surgery outliers.
MERCY HEALTH - ST. JOSEPH WARREN HOSPITAL shows Heart Failure and Shock with MCC outliers.
Most signals are one to three admissions with paid per admit up.
Reviewed cases are acute hospital PPO Local admissions with PA required code Y.
peer_benchmarking: Buckeye Health Plan validates sepsis using documentation, SOFA criteria, treatment evidence, coding, and DRG review.
Centene clinically validates sepsis using physician documentation, SOFA-supported organ dysfunction, and documented treatment.
Molina validates sepsis claims using Sepsis-3/SOFA evidence, treatment support, and admission/discharge coding details.
United Health validates principal diagnosis sequencing under ICD-10-CM and may trigger DRG 998.

recommendations.description: Audit authorized inpatient claims for PPO Local MARY WASHINGTON HOSPITAL INC in VA, PPO Local Cellulitis without MCC admissions at ME CRITICAL ACCESS and MOUNT DESERT ISLAND HOSPITAL, and Medicare HMO SSM HEALTH DEPAUL HOSPITAL - ST. LOUIS in MO for authorization denial enforcement and contractual payment accuracy; if sustained, open provider-specific site-of-care, contract remediation, and CAH preventive reviews.
evidence: MARY WASHINGTON HOSPITAL INC drove most authorized VA inpatient increase.
ME CRITICAL ACCESS cellulitis cases concentrated at MOUNT DESERT ISLAND HOSPITAL.
SSM HEALTH DEPAUL HOSPITAL ST LOUIS drove MO Medicare HMO emergence.
All source cards include auth-to-claim validation business term.
peer_benchmarking: BCBS_KC lists no DRG-specific inpatient rule; only echocardiography CPT policy is documented.
